LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 3.1.1 OBSERVING SIGNED COMPREHENSION (GRADE APPROPRIATE TEXTS)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 3.1.1 Observing signed Comprehension (Grade Appropriate Texts)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 3.1.1 Observing signed Comprehension (Grade Appropriate Texts), part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to listen or observe attentively? 2. How do the specific details in a text enhance comprehension?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

S. a) infer the meaning of words, phrases and sentences from the context, b) make connections between events in a text and reallife situations, c) value the need to comprehend the information in written texts. • In pairs, learners are guided to make predictions about a reading text. • In groups, learners are guided to infer the meaning of new words, phrases and sentences from the context. • In pairs, learners are guided to look up the meaning of new words and phrases from the dictionary. • In groups, learners are guided to relate the characters, events and places in a text to real life. • Individually, learner is guided to answer signed questions from a text. • In groups, learners are guided to make notes as they sign read a text • Individually, learner is guided to summarise the events in a text. • In pairs, learners are guided to form signed sentences using the new words and phrases • In pairs, learners are guided to fill in a crossword puzzle in pairs or small groups using the new words. the meaning of new words and phrases? 2.
